hero.titleHighlight: with a guard that checks every visitor by reputation
hero.description: Zero Plus sits as a reverse proxy between visitors and your real server. It does not treat everyone the same: it builds memory of devices it has seen and decides quickly who passes straight through and who needs a deeper check.

stats.title: The problem grows every year
stats.description: Any cheap, insecure IoT device in a home can become a weapon for a third party without the owner knowing. Traditional solutions are either very expensive or annoy visitors with CAPTCHAs.

features.title: What does Zero Plus offer?
features.description: Smarter protection that uses fewer resources, with clear, explainable logic instead of a black box.

tiered.title: Tiered Detection
tiered.desc: New devices get a light check; devices with a bad history get deeper inspection. Heavy checks are spent only where needed.

reputation.title: Reputation Score 1–10
reputation.desc: Cumulative reputation per device based only on real bad events, so new devices get a fair chance.

silent.title: Silent verification (no CAPTCHA)
silent.desc: A JS Challenge runs in the browser without bothering real visitors, and tightens as suspicion rises.

federated.title: Federated Threat Memory
federated.desc: The first customer hit by an attack immediately hardens the rest by sharing only the attacker device fingerprint—no sensitive data.

isolation.title: Strict Tenant Isolation
isolation.desc: Each company lives in its own data environment with its own encryption keys. A breach of one tenant does not spread to others.

reports.title: Human-readable reports
reports.desc: Clear text summaries for every security event, not just raw numbers—plus instant alerts when something urgent happens.

pipeline.title: Nine stages, one job each
pipeline.description: Every request passes through sequential stages. Each stage only advances who deserves the next level—so heavy checks stay rare and targeted.

roles.intake: Classifies the request: new device or known history?
roles.baseline: Silent JS Challenge for first-time visitors
roles.ipScanner: Flags traffic coming from data centers
roles.similarity: Compares IP + device fingerprint + location to history
roles.deep: Deeper match when an initial similarity is found
roles.fingerprint: TLS/JA3/JA4 checks only for suspicious devices
roles.orchestrator: Routes safe requests to your origin servers
roles.dashboard: UI that adapts to each user’s workflow
roles.isolation: Data isolation and shared threat immunity

flow.title: How does the request path change?
flow.description: No software to install. Change DNS only—we run the infrastructure.

hero.description: Zero Plus aims to make DDoS protection accessible and transparent for small and medium businesses—without enterprise cost and without annoying visitors.

vision.title: Our vision
vision.text: That every service on the internet keeps running even during an attack, and that a real visitor reaches the site smoothly as if nothing happened.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.text: Deliver graduated, smart protection: trust who deserves it, inspect deeply who raises suspicion, and share immunity across customers without compromising anyone’s privacy.

why.title: Why we built Zero Plus
why.p1: DDoS attacks are no longer a fringe issue. Cloudflare observed about 47.1 million attacks in 2025—a 121% increase over the previous year—and in December 2025 the largest attack in history was recorded at 31.4 Tbps.
why.p2: What makes this worse is that these attacks no longer rely only on compromised PCs, but on IoT devices—smart TVs, cameras, insecure routers—sitting in ordinary homes, owned by people who have no idea they are being abused.
why.p3: Small companies face two options: expensive global solutions, or CAPTCHA-heavy systems that frustrate users and sometimes block real visitors by mistake. Zero Plus is a third path: protection that checks by reputation, so it stays fast and light for legitimate visitors.

clear.title: Clear logic, not a black box
clear.desc: Allow or block decisions pass through known stages, each with one job. You can understand and review why any decision was made.

fair.title: A fair chance for every new device
fair.desc: We only register a device when a real bad event occurs (Lazy Registration). A new device is innocent until proven otherwise.

heavy.title: Heavy checks only when needed
heavy.desc: Deeper inspection (e.g. TLS/JA3/JA4) is spent on a small suspicious share, so we save resources and keep latency low.

privacy.title: Privacy that is not compromised
privacy.desc: Each company’s data stays in its isolated environment. The only thing shared is a threat fingerprint stripped of any identity.

deciders.title: Who decides, and who explains?
deciders.description: A clear split between making the security decision and phrasing it in plain language—so no sensitive decision depends on an external service.

engine.title: Zero Plus AI Engine
engine.desc: The decision engine is built and owned entirely by the project. It decides allow, block, or extra checks for every request based on the request itself (IP, device fingerprint, reputation, TLS)—with no external cloud service in the loop.

gemini.title: Gemini API
gemini.desc: It does not make any security decision. Its role starts after the decision is made: turning event data into a clear sentence or paragraph shown on the reports page and in notification text.

stack.title: Technology stack
stack.iot: ESP32 + MicroPython to simulate legitimate and attacking devices
